meta.title: Skill Pack
meta.description: Control which skills the model may auto-invoke with packs: a workspace binds one pack, and unbound workspaces follow default.

switches.title: Switches in this pack
switches.hint: Each switch has three states: on, off and follow. Follow means this pack records no decision.

chip.label: Skills
chip.goSettingsHint: Open settings switches the settings default tab to Packs; open the settings dialog itself from the sidebar gear.
